body:
This datapack is bout one of Eider's yt videos about google translate mobs chnaging theb ehavior of mobs too. The thing i was talking is a clock man form it, becuase it drops a sus clock. Now you craft it with 4 clocks and redstone! How to craft it:
1. Put a redstone in the middle of the crafting table.
2. Surround the redstone with 4 clocks.
3. Done!
